metadata.description: W3C SVG vector serialization, standalone definitions, Base64 embedded fonts, and visual parity guarantees

document_architecture.defs: Embedded Base64 fonts in @font-face, deduplicated linear/radial gradients, filters, clip-paths
document_architecture.layers: Structured group hierarchy (<g>) mirroring DOM stacking order

guarantee.name: sRGB_color_interpolation
guarantee.problem: W3C SVG defaults to linearRGB on gradients and filters, resulting in dark, muddy, desaturated colors.
guarantee.solution: TOAD explicitly sets color-interpolation="sRGB" on all gradients and color-interpolation-filters="sRGB" on all filters.

guarantee.name: expanded_filter_subregions
guarantee.problem: Default SVG filter subregion (-10% to 120%) clips blurs and shadows with radius > 12px.
guarantee.solution: TOAD expands bounds to x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%" for natural blur decay.

guarantee.name: alphabetic_baseline_parity
guarantee.problem: Mismatched baseline algorithms cause SVG text to float higher than raster Skia text.
guarantee.solution: Calculates exact baseline: y_baseline = y_node + valignShift + ascent (where ascent ≈ round(font_size * 0.80)).

guarantee.name: standalone_base64_fonts
guarantee.problem: Opening SVGs on machines without local fonts causes fallback to Arial, breaking word-wrap and layout bounds.
guarantee.solution: Converts local .ttf/.otf binaries to Base64 data URIs inside <defs><style>@font-face, guaranteeing 100% portable vector rendering.
